sloka: तमुवाच परित्रस्तं वानरेन्द्रं विभीषणः ।सबाष्पवदनं दीनं शोकव्याकुललोचनम् ।। ६.४६.३१ ।।।।
transliteration: tamuvāca paritrastaṁ vānarendraṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।sabāṣpavadanaṁ dīnaṁ śokavyākulalocanam ।। 6.46.31 ।।।।

translations.english: Sugriva was overtaken by fear on seeing Rama and Lakshmana riddled with arrows from head to foot all over the body
